description: classes.md is entirely absent (not present, not empty) from an otherwise-complete 7-file corpus; the other 6 core.ALL_FILES are present but empty (content is irrelevant to a presence/absence fault). For pmm-index-emit.cjs (`--dir` uses snapshotDir(dir,{requireAll:false})), runEmit's own missing.length check fires FIRST (before fileFaults()) and returns the dedicated missing-file:classes.md code. For pmm-hook.cjs, core.snapshot('worktree') always runs with the default requireAll=true, so ANY missing file throws a generic PmmCoreError -- but its message still names the missing file, so the hook's degraded field is not silent about which file is missing even though it takes the generic core-throw shaped path rather than a dedicated per-file code. Empirically confirmed via isolated probe before committing this fixture.
